# T-3: Scope task gates

<!-- Auto-generated by `sdd-forge spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Ensure task-level review and gate prompts use current task requirements, task spec, and task metrics instead of flow-wide requirements.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Task gate prompt input references the rendered current task spec markdown.
- Task gate prompt input does not use parent requirement ID filtering or file-map filtering.
- Task review and gate retry metrics remain task-scoped when currentTaskId is set.
- Integration gate remains flow-scoped only after no pending tasks remain or explicit broad mode is active.

## Implementation Notes
Work in prompt/context assembly paths and gate phase resolution. Preserve existing task-impl versus integration phase separation.

## Test Strategy
Prompt/context unit tests or snapshot-style assertions that currentTaskId changes the included requirement/task content.
